title: Normalized ordinary integral scalar tensor chain comparison
statement: Let ell be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_ell, iota : E → L an embedding, and W a scheme. For the recorded ordinary scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] S = integralOrdinaryScalar and total tensor products [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model] over the completed coefficient sheaves R_E and R_L, there is a unique natural isomorphism S(P tensor Q) ≅ S(P) tensor S(Q) whose degree p+q component sends 1 tensor (x tensor y) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y), for every local bidegree generator x in P^p and y in Q^q. The generators and scalar units are exactly the recorded coefficientTensorGenerator and integralOrdinaryTensorSection.

source.place: Tag 03EL, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, and section-tensor-product (balanced scalar tensor comparison and the sheafified bilinear universal property); total-complex form also used in sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 07A4.

proof.text: apply the existing normalized ordinary scalar tensor chain comparison to the canonical completed-ring map. Identify its ordinary extension functor with integralOrdinaryScalar using their exact object and morphism formulas. The sheafification-unit formula identifies its pure scalar sections with integralOrdinaryTensorSection, giving existence with the required normalization. For uniqueness, use the ordinary scalar-extension adjunction in each degree. The adjoint maps have source the ordinary total tensor; equality on its bidegree pure tensor generators follows from the two normalization formulas. Total-tensor, chain-map, natural-transformation and isomorphism extensionality give equality. No new theorem hole is introduced; all other comparison clauses retain the preceding plan.

theorem normalizedIntegralOrdinaryTensorChain (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃! α : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) ⋙
          (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≅
      ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).prod
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
          coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L W),
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (p q : ℤ)
        (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        ((α.hom.app (P, Q)).f (p + q)).val.app U
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W
            (((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
              (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)).X (p + q)) U 1
            (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
              (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) P Q p q (p + q) rfl U x y)) =
        coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, u + 1, u} (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L W)
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q (p + q) rfl U
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (P.X p) U 1 x)
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (Q.X q) U 1 y)
